in_marathi.name: Bheemavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Powerful as Bhima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheemavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bheema’, meaning powerful. In Hindu mythology, Bhima is one of the five Pandava brothers, known for his immense strength and courage.
